title: Operate refresh schedules and actionable monitoring
objective: Freshness and data-quality changes are maintained by an observable bounded process.
outcome: Refresh schedules fit selected source/spend budgets. A stale source is visible even when no collector ran successfully. Repeated unchanged failures do not generate routine notification spam. Critical new loss is not hidden by aggregate success. A successful HTTP response with the wrong resource role produces a specific changed-destination signal and cannot refresh an actionable API success badge. Public Worker has no source credentials or fetch capability. Production activation is separately receipted. Merging configuration files does not enable a timer or service. Two complete scheduled cycles remain unrun until authorized. HTTP 200 is not a completed research task. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Configure measured source refresh schedules
commits.instructions: Use per-axis/source priorities, publisher cadence, changed-content hashes and last success/attempt. Reuse job leases/outbox and document environment-specific activation.
commits.verification: Refresh schedules fit the selected source/spend budgets; a stale source is visible even when no collector ran successfully.

commits.subject: Add actionable operational signals
commits.instructions: Track queue age, failed checks, schema drift, coverage loss, budget exhaustion and review backlog. Notify on meaningful changes with affected sources and next action. Monitor redirect destination and resource-role drift separately from HTTP reachability, using the PR011 EPA API-link-to-Widgets case as a dated regression fixture.
commits.verification: Repeated unchanged failures do not generate routine notification spam; critical new loss is not hidden by aggregate success. A successful HTTP response with the wrong resource role produces a specific changed-destination signal and cannot refresh an actionable API success badge.

commits.subject: Prepare and verify runtime activation
commits.instructions: Render scoped scheduler/collector deployment configuration and run fixture/staging cycles. Obtain concrete operational authorization only after the tested artifact and rollback are reviewable.
commits.verification: Public Worker has no source credentials or fetch capability; production activation is separately receipted.
